OE02-Samples+ 1.2.11: a fork of [OpenElixir-02](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02) 1.2
for the Erica Synths LXR-02 that adds user samples and single-cycle waves from the SD card (as
oscillator and LFO waveforms, with start, length and loops), a second FX slot and a master bus
(saturation, compressor, EQ), per-track step grids, ratchets and trigger tracks, new LFO shapes
and kit/voice morphing.

> Not official Erica Synths firmware, not affiliated with or approved by Erica Synths. Install it at
> your own risk. Everything of OpenElixir-02 1.2 is the work of its author and included unchanged.

## New in 1.2.11

- The start screen and the USB-MIDI device name show the new name **OE02-Samples+**.
- **Loops stop with the sequencer:** with the amp decay at 127 a loop sample played on without
  end, also after its steps were deleted or the sequencer stopped. Stop now fades out every
  playing loop (about 2 ms); the next trigger starts it again.
- **Track 7: own waveform, pitch, sends and pan** on the shared voice of slot 6. The pages of
  track 7 show them under the same names in place of the shared parameters (edit view: "Trk7 …"):
  OSC `WAV` = waveform, sample or wave, `COA` = −24 … +24 semitones on top of track 6, AEG
  `SNA`/`SNB` = sends into FX slot A/B, MIX `PAN` (each `=T6` = as track 6). E.g. closed and open
  hi-hat samples on one voice, only the open one into the reverb. Stored in the kit.
- **OSX** (PERF page, after `VSW`): exclude single voices from the global sample rate (`SR`,
  target `0sr`); they keep their own `SRT`. Stored in the kit.
- **Cue on St2:** SHIFT + step button 1–7 cues a track (on every page). While a track is cued,
  St2 carries the cued tracks before their fader; muted cued tracks are triggered and heard on
  the cue only. `CMX` (cue … main) and `CVL` (level) on the PERF page.
- SHIFT + encoder click on the step automation page clears both locks of the selected step.
- **FX presets:** `PRS` on the setup page of FX1 and FX2: 17 factory presets and 8 user presets
  per project (`Save to U1` … `U8`, file `FXPRESET.BIN`), loaded/saved with an encoder click.
- In the edit view of `OSX`, `CHK` and `MRV` the voice buttons switch their voice.
- **LFO 2 (test):** every voice has a second LFO, track 7 its own LFO. Press the LFO button
  again on the second LFO screen ("LFO 2" / "Trk7 LFO" in the edit view). The track 7 LFO acts
  while track 7 plays, instead of the LFO of voice 6. Kit data: not morphed, no step automation.
- **Fast rolls:** PERF `ROL` has `24`, `32` and `48` (1/16 triplets, 1/32, 1/32 triplets).
- **Step accent:** `ACC` on the step page (after `PRB`) accents the selected step; `ACA` (CONFIG,
  second page) sets how much louder (+0.1 … +6 dB, default about +3.5 dB). Stored in the pattern.
- **Random voice:** SHIFT + encoder click on a voice page varies the sound of the active voice by
  `RND` (PERF page, after `CVL`, global). Volume, pan, output, sends, LFO, choke group and engine stay.
- **WAV recorder:** the last PERF screen records St1 (after FX3, DJ filter, limiter) to
  `REC/RECnnn.WAV` on the SD card, 16 bit stereo 44.1 kHz. `REC` = length (`x1`, `x2`, `x4` passes
  of the longest track, `end` = until stop), `RST` = start with PLAY (`ply`) or at the next pattern
  start (`pat`, also while running). An encoder click in the edit view arms, disarms or stops it;
  the display shows the saved file and its length. Both settings are global.
- **Modal engine (test):** a fifth engine (SHIFT + KIT, `modal`), a physical model of a struck
  membrane, bar, string, bell, plate or glass: `MDL` model, `DMP` damping, `POS` strike position,
  `INH` inharmonicity, `HRD` mallet hardness, `MAT` material, `EXC` mallet or noise.
- **FM2 engine (test):** 2-operator FM percussion (`fm2`): ratio `RAT`, index `IDX` with its own
  decay `IDC`, feedback `FBK`, pitch EG as the drum.
- **Wavetable engine (test):** (`wavetable`) scans a set of frames: `bas` sine › triangle › square ›
  saw, `usr` made from the user waves, `all`, or `t1` … `t4` from WAV files in `SAMPLES/TABLES`
  (16/24 bit or float, cycle length from the `clm` chunk of Serum and Vital, else 2048 / 256). The
  frames are lined up (no thin crossfades), real in-between waves are calculated from the harmonics,
  and each frame has band limited versions picked by pitch. `POS`, `SWP` (sweep by the pitch EG),
  `SCN` scan mode: smooth, stepped, back and forth.
- The settings of the new engines are LFO, velocity and step automation targets on every voice
  (on voice 4 and 6/7 one of them in place of the oscillator waveform target).
- Kits with the new engines play the stock engine on other firmwares.
- **Fixed:** the FX3 saturation already distorted a loud mix heavily at `SAT` 1 (its curve sat at
  full scale, while the sum before the limiter goes above it; hard to miss with the DJ low-pass,
  which leaves the folded-down distortion). The curve now has headroom and `SAT` 1 … 16 fade the
  saturated signal in. Kits with high `SAT` values sound slightly cleaner than in 1.2.10.
- The manual supplement (PDF) is for 1.2.11, with a new appendix B: all modulation and step
  automation targets with their display names (also as [docs/MOD_TARGETS.md](https://github.com/shellbeat-jpg/lxr-desktop-sample/blob/main/docs/MOD_TARGETS.md)).

## New in 1.2.10

- **User waves:** up to 8 single-cycle WAVs in `SAMPLES/WAVES` (16 bit, any length, resampled to
  1024 points; stereo: left channel only), numbered on their own (`W1` = first name).
  - Oscillator waveforms `W1`…`W8` after the sample slots, at fixed values (kits keep them when
    samples change; unused sample slots are skipped when turning). Pitch follows the note, FM works.
  - LFO shapes `W1`…`W8` (running) and `W1.`…`W8.` (one-shot, after the `OFS` delay).
  - 2 KB per wave in the sample flash; the start screen shows `Samples:N W:n`.
- **Master bus FX3** on `St1`, last in the chain before the DJ filter and the limiter (SHIFT + FX
  three times; stored in the kit, older kits: off). Three stages in any order (`ORD`: `SCE`,
  `CSE`, `ESC`, `ECS`, `SEC`, `CES`):
  - Saturation `SAT` with an optional split `FRQ` (24 dB/oct crossover, 40 Hz … 10 kHz: only the
    band above it is saturated) and `BIA`: level dependent asymmetry, even harmonics on loud
    signals, quiet ones stay symmetric.
  - Compressor (stereo linked): `TRE`, `RAT`, `ATK`, `DEC` (`AUT` = a 1/16 note of the tempo);
    crossover `CFQ` as band split (only the band above is compressed) or sidechain filter (only
    the band above drives it), `CSM`; output `AMU` (auto make-up: static or adaptive), `GAI`,
    `D/W` (parallel compression).
  - EQ: low shelf 100 Hz, two mids (frequency, gain, Q), high shelf 8 kHz.
  - `SAT` and `FRQ` are also on the PERF page after the DJ filter. The FX3 edit view shows the
    peak levels of `St1`/`St2` and the gain reduction.
  - Without a cable in `St1` the firmware plays `St1` on the `St2` jacks (stock): FX3 follows.
  - CPU: saturation and compressor together about 5 % of the audio time.
- **FX knobs:** hold SHIFT, knob 1 / 2 = input gain of FX1 / FX2 (−∞ … +12 dB, global), knob 3 / 4
  = mix of FX1 / FX2. The display shows the values for 1.5 s.
- **Pre-fader sends** (CONFIG, second page, `PRE`, global): `SNA`/`SNB` before the volume fader,
  the fader then only sets the dry signal (`OFF` = after the fader, as before). Voices with
  `OUT` = `FX`/`FXB` keep their fader.
- **FX routing `A>+`** (FX1 page, `ORD`): slot A to its own output and into slot B (send/return),
  slot B to its own output. With `A>B` a fully wet slot B leaves slot A only audible inside B.
- **Manual supplement** (PDF, in the layout of the LXR owners manual): all features of
  OE02-Samples+ 1.2.10 with parameter tables and block diagrams, attached.
- **FX signal flow** diagrams (voice → sends → FX1/FX2 → FX3 → jacks, the slot orders, the FX3
  compressor split): [docs/SAMPLES.md](https://github.com/shellbeat-jpg/lxr-desktop-sample/blob/main/docs/SAMPLES.md#fx-signal-flow),
  also attached as SVG files.
- **PERF page order:** `BPM` `ROL` `MRP` `SR` | `DJ` `RES` `SAT` `FRQ` | `SHU` `VMV` `VMO` `VSW`.
- **Fixed:** samples and user waves as the waveform of an FM oscillator (FM page `WAV`) played as
  `PWM`; they now play as selected (as FM source in `FM` mode, audible in `MIX` mode).
- The sample flash header grows to 2 KB (1 KB less sample memory). After the update the samples are
  imported again anyway.
- Kits saved with 1.2.10 load in 1.2.9 and older versions of OE02-Samples+ without FX3 (it is the
  last part of the kit's extra block).

## New in 1.2.9

- **Trigger tracks:** SHIFT + LAST STEP, click the encoder until `Trg` shows (length → grid →
  trigger mode → target). Each active step of the track (any velocity; with velocity 0 it only
  triggers, without its own sound) acts on the target track `T1` … `T7`:
  - `RST`: the target runs as usual and jumps back to step 1.
  - `MUT`: the target is muted, step by step, as long as the trigger track's steps are active.
  - `CLK`: the target only steps on these impulses (one step each, then it waits).
  Stored in the pattern (older patterns: off). Works with the step grids of both tracks.
- **LFO start:** on the same page, `LFO>[T1]` … `[T7]`: each start of the waveform of the LFO of
  the track's voice (new cycle, restart by `RTG`, one-shot after its delay) starts the target
  track at step 1, `NXT` on the next step of its grid or `NOW` at once. The target plays to its
  last step and waits; a shorter LFO cycle restarts it earlier (loop). A restart caused by the
  target's own trigger doesn't count. A track can have a trigger target and an LFO target; each
  target has one source only (targets already in use are skipped when choosing).
- **Fixed (stock firmware):** an LFO modulating another LFO (e.g. its rate `FRQ`) only worked on
  LFOs with a higher number (LFO 1 → LFO 2, not LFO 3 → LFO 1): the modulation was reset before
  the lower LFO was calculated. Now it works between all LFOs (also an LFO on itself).

## New in 1.2.8

- **Step flam:** new values `X12`, `X24`, `X4+`/`X4-` (velocity slope) and roll locks `1/8`, `1/4`,
  `1/2`, `1/1`: the step repeats every 2/4/8/16 steps of its track until the next active step.
- **Second FX slot:** `FX2` = project FX (slot B), next to the kit's FX (`FX1`, slot A), with the
  same effects `OFF`, `DRV`, `RNG`, `CMP`, `DEL`. SHIFT + FX = FX1, SHIFT + FX again = FX2. Voice
  output `FXB` goes to FX2.
- **FX sends:** `SNA` (into slot A) and `SNB` (into slot B) per voice on the AEG page, besides the
  voice's output, stored in the kit (a block after the engine block; older kits: 0). Meant for
  outputs `St1` … `R2`; with `OUT` = `FX`/`FXB` they raise the level in the same slot or also
  feed the other one. The outputs `1+A` … `R2B` of the first 1.2.8 test builds are gone (such
  voices play dry).
- **FX routing** (FX1 page, after the effect parameters, `ORD`): `A>B` (default, as before with B off), `B>A`,
  `A+B` (parallel, each slot to its own output).
- **Delay tempo sync** `SYA`/`SYB`: `1/4`, `1/8.`, `1/4T`, `1/8`, `1/16.`, `1/8T`, `5/64`, `1/16`,
  `1/32.`, `1/16T`, `1/32`, `1/32T`, following the tempo.
- FX2 and the sync are kept with the global settings (SAVE → Global) and in the project file; the
  order is stored in the kit.
- **Fixed:** the knobs changed `CHK` as a number instead of switching the active voice on/off
  (e.g. tracks 1 and 2 on, turned on → track 3 on as well). The same for `SNA`/`SNB`, `MRV`, `VSW`,
  `ORD`, `SYA`/`SYB` and `VMV`: the knobs now change them like the encoder.

## New in 1.2.7

- **Step grid per track:** SHIFT + LAST STEP, click the encoder to edit the grid: `1/4`, `1/4T`,
  `1/8`, `1/16.` (6/4), `1/8T`, `5/64` (5/4), `1/16` (default), `1/32.` (3/4), `1/16T`, `1/32`, `1/32T`, for
  polyrhythms. The 1/16
  tracks keep their timing; stored in the pattern (older patterns: `1/16`). Roll follows the
  track's own steps; live recording is quantized to 1/16.

## Changed in 1.2.6

- Samples are shown as `S1`..`S31` (was `s1`..`s31`).

## New in 1.2.5

- **Voice morph switch point** `VSW` (performance page, after `VMO`): the amount at which
  switch-like values (sample/waveform, filter type ...) change to the target's, 1..127 (default 64),
  one value per source voice; kept with the global settings (SAVE → Global or a project save).
- **Fixed:** turning `VMO` made the source voice jump in pitch while turning. The voice morph now
  sends its values in small steps, like the kit morph.

## New in 1.2.4

- **Mod wheel** (MIDI CC 1) on the global MIDI channel sets the kit morph `MRP`.
- **Morph target quick access:** `MRP` 0 → 127 morphs from the start value in the active kit to the
  target value in the morph kit. In the edit view of a sound parameter hold **SHIFT**: the display
  shows `Morph>` and the target value, the encoder edits it; SHIFT + encoder click sets it to
  the active value, so the parameter doesn't morph.
- **Voices of the kit morph** (global settings, second page, `MRV`): kit morph on/off per voice.
- Global settings (CONFIG pages, e.g. `IPS`, `MRV`) apply at once but are only kept after a
  restart when saved: SAVE, type **Global** (or with a project save, Save → Project).
- **Velocity 0** on a step: only the step automation is applied, the voice isn't triggered.
- **LFO range display:** the edit view of an LFO's `MOD` shows the range its target moves in.
- **Instant pattern switching** (global settings, second page, `IPS`): a pattern selected by hand
  starts on the next step at the same position.
- **LFO waveforms** `XTR` (exponential triangle) and the one-shots `SI1` `TR1` `SU1` `SD1` `SQ1`
  `RN1` `XU1` `XD1` `XT1`: one cycle per trigger, then hold; `OFS` = delay before the start; `RN1`
  = a new random value per trigger; `SQ1` = a gate after each trigger.

## Fixed in 1.2.4

- Dark display at the start: the two extra display initializations added in 1.2.2 are removed
  again (the display is initialized once, as in 1.2.1). Switching the unit on again immediately
  after switching it off can still leave the display dark: **wait about 10 seconds** before
  switching on again.

## New in 1.2.3: voice morph

On the performance page, after the DJ filter (scroll on with the encoder):

- `VMV` selects a source and a target voice (`1>2` ... `6>5`, `OFF`).
- `VMO` morphs the source's sound towards the target's (0 = as set, 127 = the target's values):
  pitch, envelopes, filter, FM, sample start, LFO ...; switch-like values change at half, engine
  specific parameters only between voices with the same engine.
- Not saved, the voices keep their own settings.

## Changed in 1.2.2

- The start screen shows the sample memory (`Used x.x/5.9s`) instead of the chip's flash size.

## New in 1.2.1 (first release of OE02-Samples+, compared with OpenElixir-02 1.2)

- **Sample import at boot** from `SAMPLES` (one-shots) and `SAMPLES/LOOPS` (loops): up to 31 WAV
  files, 16 bit, mono or stereo, any sample rate, about 5.9 s in total at 44.1 kHz. Imported only
  when the folder changed, verified after writing; invalid files or files that don't fit are skipped
  and reported; the start screen shows the number of samples and the memory used.
- **Experimental 1.5 MB sample memory** (about 17.8 s) with a file or folder `BIGFLASH` in
  `SAMPLES`: uses the flash above the 1 MB the chip reports; not guaranteed by ST, falls back to
  512 KB on errors.
- **Samples as oscillator waveforms** S1..SN after the built-in waveforms (coarse 60 = original
  pitch, FM works); the edit view shows the file name.
- **Start and length** (`STA` = the PWM knob while a sample is selected, `LEN` on drum 1-3), shown in
  ms, stored in kits, with short fades against clicks.
- **Loops** between start and end, crossfaded at the loop point.
- **Modulated sample selection**: LFO/velocity modulation of `WAV` selects within a range (start =
  the selected sample, size = `MOD`/`AMT`); LFO waveform **`CYC`** steps through the range, one
  sample per trigger (round robin); on other targets `CYC` steps the same way
  (`MOD` = number of steps). The sample is chosen at the trigger; retriggers fade the old
  sound out.
- **Choke group** per kit (`CHK` on the AEG page).
- **Voice INIT templates** per project and global in the voice load menu (LOAD + step button).
- Waveform modulation targets are shown as `WAV` (main oscillator), `FWV` (FM oscillator), `CWV`
  (transient).

## From OpenElixir-02 1.2 (compared with the Erica Synths firmware)

The work of Moritz Waser, included unchanged; details in the
[OpenElixir-02 release notes](https://github.com/tunefish777/openelixir-02/releases).

- **Kit management:** load single voices from any kit of any project (LOAD + step button 1-7);
  "Change Project" in the load and save kit menus.
- **Freely assignable voice engines:** each voice slot runs drum, snare, cymbal or hi-hat (SHIFT +
  KIT), saved in the kit.
- **Limiter** on each output after a 32 bit sum (config `LIM`).
- **DJ filter** on the final mix (performance page `DJ`, `RES`).
- **Uninterrupted playback** while turning knobs, using the menus, loading and saving.
- **Under the hood:** about 10 % less CPU load, many bug fixes of the stock firmware (MIDI,
  sequencer, SD card, memory corruption), a safe project save.

All features: [README](https://github.com/shellbeat-jpg/lxr-desktop-sample#what-this-fork-adds) and
[docs/SAMPLES.md](https://github.com/shellbeat-jpg/lxr-desktop-sample/blob/main/docs/SAMPLES.md).

## Installing

1. Download `LXR_OE02-Samples_V1.2.11.img`.
2. Copy it to the top folder of the SD card and delete any other `LXR*.img` files there.
3. Switch the LXR-02 off, insert the card, hold the encoder button and switch it on; keep holding it
   until "LXR Updater" appears.
4. Wait for "Update OK!", then remove the image from the card.
5. Keep your WAV files in `SAMPLES` and switch on normally: the update erased the samples, they are
   imported again at the first start.
6. Optional, experimental: a folder (or file) `BIGFLASH` in `SAMPLES` gives about 17.8 s instead of
   5.9 s of samples. It uses flash above the 1 MB the chip reports, which ST doesn't guarantee; every
   sample is verified, errors fall back to 512 KB. If the unit ever hangs at the start screen,
   remove `BIGFLASH` (or start without card).
7. Recommended: after switching off, wait about 10 seconds before switching on again (otherwise the
   display can stay dark; the unit still works).

## Going back

Install the OpenElixir-02 or the Erica Synths image the same way. Kits saved with this firmware load
there; start, length, the choke group and the new LFO waveforms are ignored, voices with a sample as
waveform stay silent.
